resume_document.headline: Junior Full-Stack AI Engineer | Flutter, Python & RAG Systems
resume_document.summary: Junior Full-Stack and AI Engineer experienced in building cross-platform Flutter applications, textbook-grounded RAG pipelines, and scalable REST APIs. Proven background delivering mobile features across commercial applications, optimizing backend query performance, and building Python-driven LLM and agentic workflows.

bullets.text: Integrated more than 20 REST API endpoints, Firebase authentication and realtime data into commercial Flutter workflows.
Contributed to development and maintenance across six Flutter applications with responsive screens, reusable widgets and backend-connected features.
Worked on Node.js/Express/MongoDB backend services and MVVM/BLoC state management.
Optimized LMS database queries and indexing; reported p95 API latency improved from 1,100 ms to 420 ms (about 62%).
Enhanced Talib dashboard loading using caching, lazy loading and pagination; reported 3.2s to 1.4s (about 56%) load-time improvement.
Worked on customer booking, dashboard and repair-status integration journeys as company development scope.
Co-developed textbook-grounded RAG capabilities using embedding-based semantic retrieval and FAISS.
Developed Flutter student-facing learning experiences connected to backend APIs.
Implemented AI-assisted quiz and flashcard generation and learning summary functionality.
Implemented Gmail attachment and direct-PDF intake, PDF parsing and extraction into structured candidate profiles.
Built deterministic ATS matching with required/preferred skills, experience signals and transparent comparison breakdowns.
Implemented master career profile models, JSON persistence, JD analysis, fact retrieval and initial writer/evaluator nodes in LangGraph.
Designed and developed multi-tenant and multi-branch mobile-retail ERP/POS workflows covering inventory, sales, customer credit and repairs.
Implemented Supabase authentication, branch/tenant access boundaries using PostgreSQL row-level security and protected RPC workflows.

previous_evaluation_feedback: Source-fact bullet corrections applied; full semantic re-evaluation required.
